Let me reconsider the mechanics:
1. Clicking a cross creates a shadow (g colored) at a specific position
2. Clicking the shadow merges the adjacent crosses into one at the shadow position
3. The goal might be to reduce all 5 crosses to a single one, or to arrange them in a specific pattern
Previously I:
1. Clicked cross 1 → shadow appeared at position 4
2. Clicked shadow at position 4 → merged crosses 1 & 2 into one at position 4
3. Clicked cross 3 → shadow appeared at position 2
4. Clicked shadow at position 2 → merged remaining crosses into one g cross at position 2
But this left 3 g crosses total (1 in top room, 2 in bottom room). Maybe the goal is to merge ALL crosses, not just the top room ones.
Let me restart and try a different approach. I'll click crosses one at a time and see what shadows appear, then figure out the right sequence to merge all 5 crosses.
